run_binarized_mnist_generator: run the binarized_mnist module to generate fake binarized MNIST image files for testing
create_make_images: create a function that generates random 28x28 image arrays with uint8 pixel values
create_write_image_file: create a function that writes random image data to an .amat file using numpy savetxt
build_examples_dir_path: build the path to the tensorflow_datasets testing fake_examples directory
build_mnist_dir_path: build the path to a specific MNIST dataset directory within fake_examples
